Private Function Tried(ByVal which As Long, ByVal folder As String) As String
    Dim wb As Workbook, d As Object, o As Object, ch As Object, s As String, v As String, r As Variant
    Set wb = Workbooks.Add(xlWBATWorksheet)
    Set d = wb.Worksheets(1): d.Name = "Data"
    Set o = wb.Worksheets.Add(After:=d): o.Name = "Other": d.Activate
    d.Range("A1:A8").Value = Application.Transpose(Array("k", "a", "b", "c", "d", "e", "f", "g"))
    d.Range("B1:B8").Value = Application.Transpose(Array("v", 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7))
    d.Range("C1:C8").Value = Application.Transpose(Array("w", 11, 12, 13, 14, 15, 16, 17))
    d.Range("D1:D8").Value = Application.Transpose(Array("x", 21, 22, 23, 24, 25, 26, 27))
    d.Range("F1:F4").Value = Application.Transpose(Array(31, 32, 33, 34))
    o.Range("A1:A3").Value = Application.Transpose(Array(41, 42, 43))
    d.Range("J1").Select
    Set ch = d.ChartObjects.Add(300, 100, 300, 200).Chart
    On Error GoTo Failed
    Select Case which \ 100
    Case 0: Act0 which, d, o, ch, r
    Case 1: Act1 which, d, o, ch, r
    End Select
    s = "ok "
Answered:
    On Error Resume Next
    Err.Clear
    v = "": v = CStr(r)
    If Err.Number Then v = "E" & Err.Number
    s = s & "|" & v
    Err.Clear
    v = ""
    v = ch.SeriesCollection.Count
    If Err.Number Then v = "E" & Err.Number
    s = s & "|" & v
    Err.Clear
    v = ""
    v = ch.SeriesCollection(1).Formula
    If Err.Number Then v = "E" & Err.Number
    s = s & "|" & v
    Err.Clear
    v = ""
    v = ch.SeriesCollection(2).Formula
    If Err.Number Then v = "E" & Err.Number
    s = s & "|" & v
    Err.Clear
    v = ""
    v = ch.SeriesCollection(3).Formula
    If Err.Number Then v = "E" & Err.Number
    s = s & "|" & v
    Err.Clear
    v = ""
    v = ch.SeriesCollection(1).Name
    If Err.Number Then v = "E" & Err.Number
    s = s & "|" & v
    Err.Clear
    v = ""
    v = ch.SeriesCollection(2).Name
    If Err.Number Then v = "E" & Err.Number
    s = s & "|" & v
    Err.Clear
    v = ""
    v = ch.SeriesCollection(1).Points.Count
    If Err.Number Then v = "E" & Err.Number
    s = s & "|" & v
    Err.Clear
    v = ""
    v = ch.PlotBy
    If Err.Number Then v = "E" & Err.Number
    s = s & "|" & v
    Err.Clear
    v = ""
    v = ch.HasLegend
    If Err.Number Then v = "E" & Err.Number
    s = s & "|" & v
    On Error GoTo 0
    Tried = s
    wb.SaveAs folder & "\c" & which & ".xlsx", xlOpenXMLWorkbook
    wb.Close False
    Exit Function
Failed:
    s = "Err " & Err.Number & " "
    Resume Answered
End Function

Public Function Probe(ByVal folder As String, ByVal first As Long, ByVal last As Long) As String
    Dim i As Long, s As String
    Application.DisplayAlerts = False
    For i = first To last
        s = s & "@@@" & Tried(i, folder)
    Next
    Application.DisplayAlerts = True
    Probe = Mid(s, 4)
End Function
